place.raw: Cohawkin, Pilesgrove, Salem, New Jersey, USA

notes: PARENT-TOO-YOUNG RESOLVED 2026-07-04 as a probable misattached child, not a birth-year typo for Miriam herself. Correcting Miriam's own birth year does not rescue the link: her mother, Miriam Howell (I182541964296), is recorded (also unsourced) as born 1664 in England — which caps Miriam Johnson's own earliest plausible birth at roughly 1680-1686 (her mother's realistic fertile window), leaving her at most 6-12 years old at the 1692 birth of the listed child, Tamzen/Tamzon Standford, under ANY internally-consistent correction. No shift of Miriam's own birth year resolves the problem the way it did in comparable cases elsewhere in this tree.

External research surfaces a well-documented, internally coherent alternative identity for the child: WikiTree's 'Tamzen (Paullin) Elwell' (Paullin-46, https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Paullin-46, redirected from Paulin-332), b. 1688 (guess) Bucks County, Pennsylvania, d. 1739 Pilesgrove, Salem Co., NJ, m. Samuel Elwell (matching this tree's I182381534759 exactly, including his 1685/1688 birth and 1740 death) with 12 children born 1714-1740 in Pilesgrove/Pittsgrove, NJ (dates marked 'certain' on several). She is recorded there as one of at least six siblings — Henry (b. 1681), William (b. abt.1682, WikiTree Paullin-17, d. 1757 Pilesgrove NJ), Mary (b. 1686), Tamzen (b. 1688), Simon (b. 1692), Elizabeth (b. 1694) Paullin — children of Henry Paullin (b. abt 1650, Padbury, Buckinghamshire, England; d. abt 1723, Salem, New Jersey; WikiTree Paullin-65), an English Quaker family that relocated from Bucks County, PA to Salem/Pilesgrove, NJ — exactly matching where 'our' Tamzen died and married. This is a materially better-corroborated (sibling-consistent, place-consistent) parentage than the 'Thomas Standford + Miriam Cohawkin' attribution, which traces to an uncorroborated compiled Ancestry page ('Tamzen OR Tamzon Mulford STANDFORD 1692-1740') and to this tree's own math-impossible record.

Best current judgment: the Standford/Cohawkin parentage for Tamzen is very likely a mis-hint (an Ancestry-style name/place coincidence — both families ended up in Pilesgrove, Salem Co., NJ around the same years), and Tamzen's real parents are Henry Paullin and an as-yet-unidentified wife, not this Miriam. Not certain (Tamzen's birth year varies 1688 vs. 1692 between sources, and no source names Henry Paullin's wife), so this is reported as the likely explanation rather than a fabricated certainty. Miriam Johnson/Cohawkin's own recorded birth (1680) and death (08 Jan 1722) are themselves unsourced but not otherwise contradicted; her true children, if any survive in the record, are undetermined. Machine-owned relationships arrays left unedited per repo convention. See docs/research/ancestors/gen11-miriam-johnson-cohawkin.md.

This is the SAME Paullin family already independently confirmed elsewhere in this tree: William Paullin (I182541959101, Tamzen's own brother per WikiTree) was matched, in an unrelated already-resolved case, against WikiTree Paullin-17 on his exact birth/death (abt. 1682 Bucks Co., PA – abt. 12 Nov 1757 Pilesgrove, Salem, NJ); see docs/research/ancestors/gen11-anne-henley.md. Two independently-investigated tree errors converging on the same real family meaningfully strengthens this identification.
